title: might / might not (possibility)
en:
might + infinitive — something is possible (maybe): I might be late. It might rain later.

might not (mightn't) — maybe not: The director might not come today.

may has a similar meaning and is a little more formal. Compare: will = sure; might = possible: It will be cold (I'm sure). It might snow (maybe).

No to after might: might go, not might to go.
ru: might + глагол — возможно, может быть (I might be late). might not — возможно, не… may — похоже, чуть формальнее. will — уверен, might — не уверен. После might — без to.

boss.situation: Write about possible risks for next month: what might happen and what might not happen.
samples: Next month the supplier might deliver the equipment late.
We might not have enough staff during the holidays.
The auditors might ask for more documents.
Prices might go up, so we may need a bigger budget.
If that happens, the project might be delayed.
